why: The Teams ring's shape is keyed to the team instead of the slot (issue #1128): every tank on a side draws one outline, so two teammates read as one player, and the ring's shape repeats what its color already says. The ruling gives the two channels one meaning each: the shape says which player, the color which side. Every ring is still a `shape` outline in its team's color, so the FFA cases and the color cases stay green.
